hints.title: Unique Cycle Property
hints.text: The graph is connected with n vertices and n edges, which means it contains exactly one simple cycle.

hints.title: Pruning Degree-1 Leaves
hints.text: Use Kahn algorithm logic: repeatedly remove vertices with degree 1 until only the vertices forming the cycle remain.

hints.title: Multi-Source Breadth Search
hints.text: Initialize a queue with all vertices on the cycle with distance 0, and expand outward to compute distance for all remaining tree branches.

hints.title: Pruning and Multi-Source BFS Implementation

complexity.notes: Leaf pruning and multi-source BFS each run in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a separate cycle detection and BFS from every single node takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Degree arrays, cycle indicators, and distance queues use O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies pseudo-tree structure and applies Kahn leaf-stripping to isolate the cycle.
